subject: Request: Q4 platform demo (preferred 12/28) — Redwood year-end blackout
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@fincorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Q4 platform demo (Dec 28 preferred)

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — we’re trying to get a short platform walkthrough scheduled for our security and procurement teams before year-end. Ideally we’d like to do it the week of Dec 28 so it’s fresh before our vendor evaluation closes. Our first-choice slot would be Monday 12/28 at 11:00am ET (I know it’s tight).

High-level agenda: short overview (10m), architecture/security deep dive (25m), Q&A (15m). I attached a one-page agenda. Can you confirm availability or propose alternatives?

Participants from our side: myself (Daniel Kim), +1 from procurement (salesops@fincorp.com). This is tied to our upcoming procurement window — timing is important for the approval committee.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim
Senior IT Procurement Manager
FinCorp

Attachment: FinCorp-demo-agenda.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 platform demo (Dec 28 preferred)

Hi Daniel — thanks for the note and the agenda. Quick heads-up: Redwood has a company-wide year-end reduced-support window and many engineers will be on a scheduled shutdown Dec 27–31. We try to keep critical customer coverage, but the deck is thinner that week and our preferred practice is to avoid scheduling live deep-dives on blackout days.

Two immediate options:
- Move earlier: Dec 22–23 (several slots free) — full engineering + SE present.
- Move to early January: Jan 4–8, with priority scheduling (we can lock in an SE and an engineering lead).

If your timeline is firm on the 28th, we can still do a *recorded* deep-dive or a short live exec overview with follow-up recorded technical session during our January window. Tell me which you'd prefer and I’ll coordinate.

Sorry for the inconvenience — want to make sure you get the right people on the call.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-12-08T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Q4 platform demo (Dec 28 preferred)

Naomi / Monica — quick internal. FinCorp is approaching a renewal milestone in Q1 and procurement wants a recorded deep-dive + live Q&A to close controls questions. If we push to Jan we should mark Jan 5–7 as priority so they don’t go dark.

My recommended play: offer two live options (one in the last week available before blackout, i.e., Dec 23, and one in the first week of January). That gives them flexibility and keeps the deal moving. If they take the Dec 23 slot we’ll need to confirm SE coverage ASAP.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to include milestone dates and who owns each deliverable.

- Rishi
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
